name: handoff-after-compact
description: Session 1 writes the note as in handoff-note-roundtrip. Session 2, with async-compaction loaded beside it, gets the note at its first prompt, runs /compact as a follow-up turn, and gets the note once more at the next prompt, under the compaction wording.

sessions.name: edit two files
sessions.prompt: Add an exported function subtract(a, b) that returns a - b to src/math.js, and an exported function shout(s) that returns s.toUpperCase() + '!' to src/strings.js. Use the Edit tool for both files. Do not run anything. When both edits are done, reply with one short line.

assert.label: debug log: the note was written
store holds a note for the temp repo

sessions.name: prompt, /compact, prompt
turns: Without using any tools, reply with one short line: ready.
Without using any tools, say in one sentence what was last done in this repository.

assert.label: after-compaction note once
assert.matches: ^\[handoff\] The conversation was just compacted; the summary above stays as it is, and this note is added beside it\.
